question:
Study the bar chart. In which year maximum percentage increase in production was recorded as compared to the previous year?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7149535a6ee3e94a81500c28875e09e82ad17e8db00b03fe0917d0735dc9a38e.png] 

Reference: [production of wheat (in 1000 tonnes) over the years ]

In which year maximum percentage increase in production was recorded as compared to the previous year?
solution:
**Given:**

Bar chart showing wheat production (in 1000 tonnes) for the years 2016 to 2021.

**Formula used:**

Percentage increase = frac{{New value - Old value}}{{Old value}} times 100

**Calculation:**

Step 1: Calculate percentage increases year-wise:

2017: (140 - 125)/(125) times 100 = 12%

2018: (150 - 140)/(140) times 100 = 7.14%

2019: (165 - 150)/(150) times 100 = 10%

2020: (210 - 165)/(165) times 100 = 27.27%

2021: (225 - 210)/(210) times 100 = 7.14%

Step 2: Identify the maximum percentage increase:

⇒ Maximum percentage increase = 27.27% in the year 2020.

**∴ Maximum percentage increase in production was recorded in 2020.**
